notices.noticeTitle: Register to use and get discounts
notices.noticeContent: Create a free account to like products, follow stores and get member discounts from participating stores.

notices.noticeTitle: It’s absolutely free to upload and trade products
notices.noticeContent: Stores pay no listing fee — florists, bakers and chocolatiers can list as many products as they like.

notices.noticeTitle: Report a problem with a store or product
notices.noticeContent: If a product is not as described, call customer care with the store name and product link and we will follow up with the store.

notices.noticeTitle: Shop by occasion — Birthday, Wedding, Anniversary and Holiday
notices.noticeContent: Every product now has an occasion, so you can filter the catalog and the home search by the event you are shopping for.
Share what you made, ask the makers and find gift ideas on the Free, Recommendation, News and Humor boards.

notices.noticeTitle: Store profiles now show covers, cities and categories
notices.noticeContent: Browse the Stores directory by city or category and see each store’s cover photo, products and likes.

faqs.noticeTitle: What can I buy on Navano?
faqs.noticeContent: Flowers, chocolates and cakes made by independent local stores. Each product shows its type, occasion, city and how many items are available.

faqs.noticeTitle: Are the products up to date?
faqs.noticeContent: Stores manage their own listings. Products on hold or sold out are marked on the card, and deleted products disappear from search.

faqs.noticeTitle: How do I find a gift for a specific event?
faqs.noticeContent: Use the occasion filter (Birthday, Wedding, Anniversary, Holiday) in the home search or on the Products page, and combine it with a city and a category.

faqs.noticeTitle: How do I contact a store?
faqs.noticeContent: Open the store page from the Stores directory or from a product, and use the contact details or comments there.

faqs.noticeTitle: How do I save products I like?
faqs.noticeContent: Tap the heart on a product. Liked products appear under My Favorites on My Page, and products you opened appear under Recently Visited.

faqs.noticeTitle: Is there a fee for buyers?
faqs.noticeContent: No. Browsing products, liking them and following stores on Navano is free.

faqs.noticeTitle: How do I open a store?
faqs.noticeContent: Sign up and choose the Store role. After you log in, use Add Product on My Page to list your bouquets, cakes or chocolates.

faqs.noticeTitle: Does it cost anything to list products?
faqs.noticeContent: No, listing products on Navano is free.

faqs.noticeTitle: How do I mark a product as sold out or on hold?
faqs.noticeContent: Go to My Products on My Page and change the product status. Buyers see an “On hold” or “Sold out” label on the card.

faqs.noticeTitle: How do I change my photo or address?
faqs.noticeContent: Open My Page, then My Profile, update the fields and press Update profile.

faqs.noticeTitle: I forgot my password. What should I do?
faqs.noticeContent: Call customer care and we will help you get back into your account.

faqs.noticeTitle: Who can write in the community?
faqs.noticeContent: Any logged-in member can write articles on the Free, Recommendation, News and Humor boards and comment on posts.

faqs.noticeTitle: What is not allowed in the community?
faqs.noticeContent: Spam, advertising that has nothing to do with flowers, cakes or chocolates, and personal attacks. Administrators can remove such posts.
